story: Multiple riders attempted early breakaways but failed initially. After a crash involving Arensman and Vacek, the race continued. Around 60 km in, a serious breakaway gained up to three minutes. Baudin, the last of the leaders, aimed for the yellow jersey. Ultimately, GC contenders fought for victory, with Pogačar winning thanks to Del Toro's support, taking the yellow jersey from nearest rival Vingegaard.
